responsibility: Implements the default-channel wrapper for REAL text I/O by delegating to RealIO on StdChans standard channels. It forwards reading to the current input channel and writing to the current output channel, serving as the convenience façade above the channel-based REAL formatting and parsing layer.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation layer for SRealIO, forwarding REAL reads and writes to RealIO on StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. It differs from SRealIO.def, which only publishes the default-channel REAL I/O signatures.
